title: One Stop Shop Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard: Sold Exclusively at Foreman Mills
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 350.

title: Westinghouse Portable Generators Recalled by MWE Investments Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The portable generators can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,500.

title: Metabo Recalls Rat Tail Angle Grinders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The on-off switch can lock in the "on" position, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,100.

title: Netgear Recalls Power Adapters for Outdoor Cameras Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Water can leak into the weatherproof connector on the power adapter and cause a short circuit, melting, and overheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,300 (In addition, about 400 were sold in Canada).

title: West Elm Recalls Table Lamps Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The electrical wire that runs through the lamps can be cut or fray by the lamp's adjustable joint, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. Units: About 43,000.

title: Camso Recalls Dirt to Snow Bike Conversion Kits Due to Crash and Impact Hazards
summary: The pin that secures the brake pads can loosen, posing a crash or impact hazard. Units: About 280 (In addition, 316 were sold in Canada).

title: ACE Work Boots Recalled by Shoes for Crews Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The work boots were advertised as puncture-resistant, but were not manufactured with the puncture-resistant plate, posing an injury hazard to users. Units: About 4,300.

title: Vilo Home Recalls Marseille Dining Benches Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foam seat cushion and base can crack in the middle and cause the bench to collapse, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 200.

title: American Honda Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The carburetor can leak gasoline, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 34,000.

title: Brompton Bicycle Recalls Bicycles Due To Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's bottom bracket can break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 8,400 (In addition, about 1,300 were sold in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls Crossover Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering shaft can separate from the steering rack assembly and result in a loss of vehicle steering control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 68,300.

title: Melville Direct Recalls Fiber Optic Christmas Trees Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The AC power adapter can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP 4 Turbo Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The return fuel line can be improperly secured which can cause fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 560.

title: Wohali Outdoors Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Bass Pro Shops
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 26,800 in the U.S. (In addition, 2,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: Matrix Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Violation of Federal Standard; Explosion and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory standard for this product. title: Monte Carlo Recalls Ceiling Fans Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The brackets connected to the fan blades can break, causing the blades to fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 3,400 (In addition, about 50 were sold in Canada).

title: Squatty Potty Recalls Children's Toilet Step Stools Due to Injury and Fall Hazards
summary: The top removable step (hat) on the recalled children's toilet step stools can detach while a child is standing on it, posing injury and fall hazards. Units: About 2,400.

title: Superior Importers Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,200.

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Benches Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The benches can tip over while in use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 6,800 (in addition, 575 units were sold in Canada).

title: Hunter Fan Recalls Ceiling Fans Due to Impact Injury Hazard; New Instructions Provided
summary: The owner's manual instructs consumers to install the light globe incorrectly and the light globe can fall, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 168,000 (In addition, about 1,900 in Canada).

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Decorative Glass Pumpkins Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The wooden stem on the top of the decorative pumpkin can detach when picked up, causing the glass pumpkin base to fall and break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 16,600 units in the U.S. (In addition, about 430 units were sold in Canada.).

title: Todd Snyder Recalls Sweatshirts Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards
summary: The sweatshirts fail to meet federal flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a burn risk to users. Units: About 2,100 in the U.S. (In addition, 40 were sold in Canada.).

title: Dream On Me Recalls Crib & Toddler Bed Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 23,400.

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rollover protective structure (ROPS) at the back of the tractor can loosen and fail to protect the operator in a rollover accident, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 3,300 (in addition, 380 were sold in Canada).

title: Ravin Crossbows Recalls Arrow Nocks Due to Injury Hazard
summary: If the nock is not fully engaged with the bowstring, the crossbow can fail to discharge when the trigger is pulled and can result in the bow discharging while re-nocking of the arrow, posing an injury hazard to users. Units: About 220,000 nocks (In addition, about 3,600 nocks were sold in Canada).

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Toddler Beds Due to Entrapment Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The headboard can disconnect from the bed frame and fall onto the bed, posing an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 75.

title: Western Gas Recalls to Inspect Propane Gas Due To Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled propane may not contain sufficient levels of odorant to help alert consumers to a gas leak. Failure to detect leaking gas can present fire, explosion and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 45.7 million gallons.

title: HealthPostures Recalls IntimateRider Chair and RiderMate Bench Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stitching on the cloth cover can loosen, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 100.

title: Rocky Mountain Bicycles Recall Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake cable housing was not secured properly during manufacturing, which can cause brake failure, posing a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,300 (in addition, 1,800 were sold in Canada).
